description: Unit tests for NameConstraints in the net::cert::pki namespace, testing various aspects of certificate name constraints handling including DNS names, directory names, IP addresses, and subject alternative names.

classes.name: ParseNameConstraints
classes.description: Test fixture class for parameterized tests of NameConstraints criticality.

methods.name: LoadTestData
methods.description: Loads test data from PEM files based on token and basename.

methods.name: LoadTestNameConstraint
methods.description: Loads test data for name constraints.

methods.name: LoadTestSubjectAltName
methods.description: Creates GeneralNames object from test data.

methods.name: IsPermittedCert
methods.description: Checks if a certificate with given name constraints and subject data is permitted.
